components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary, #059669); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(4,120,87,0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover, #047857); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--brand-press, #036549); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand, #059669) 25%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-3, #f1f3f2); color: var(--text-subtle, #66716a); border-color: var(--border, #e6e9e7); box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button

components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); display: block; width: 260px; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-subtle, #66716a); } .ds-field-label b { color: var(--red, #dc2626); } .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d6dad8); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #14211b); font-size: 13.5px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-subtle, #66716a); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--brand, #059669); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand, #059669) 20%, transparent); } .ds-field-hint { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-faint, #68736c); }

components.css: .ds-pill { font-family: var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-red { background: var(--red-soft, #fef2f2); color: var(--red, #dc2626); border-color: var(--red-border, #fbd5d5); } .ds-amber { background: var(--amber-soft, #fff8eb); color: var(--amber, #c2700a); border-color: var(--amber-border, #fae3b8); } .ds-blue { background: var(--blue-soft, #eff5ff); color: var(--blue, #2563eb); border-color: var(--blue-border, #d3e2fd); } .ds-violet { background: var(--violet-soft, #f6f3ff); color: var(--violet, #7c3aed); border-color: var(--violet-border, #e6dcfb); } .ds-green { background: var(--green-soft, #ecfdf5); color: var(--green, #059669); border-color: var(--green-border, #c4ecd9); } .ds-slate { background: var(--slate-soft, #f1f5f9); color: var(--slate, #475569); border-color: transparent; }

narrative.overview:
This is the room the brokerage works in from opening to close. A green-tinted grey desk (Morning Desk) holds white cards that each carry one job, set in Hanken Grotesk at a dense 12–14px so a full queue fits without scrolling past the point of comfort. The system stays quiet so that the few things that need attention are unmistakable: an overdue renewal in red, a waiting document in amber, a proposal in violet. Policy Green is the one voice of action.

Quiet is not timid. Controls are tactile and confident: the primary button is a solid green fill with a small lift of shadow and a clear hover, inputs show a green ring when focused, and a blocked action drops its colour entirely rather than fading. The goal is the feeling that everything is going according to plan and every person and record is accounted for.

It must not read as a generic CRM: no stock dashboard of identical metric tiles, no decoration standing in for information, no colour that doesn't carry a status. Both a light and a dark theme ship, with the same roles.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (Policy Green) for action and the current place; status colours only for status.
White cards with hairline borders and a small ambient shadow on a tinted desk.
Dense, legible type: 14px body, 11.5px uppercase labels, tabular figures for money and counts.
Gently rounded corners (7 / 10 / 14px); pills only for small status chips.
Every interactive control has visible hover, focus and disabled states.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Policy Green is the only accent. It marks action and the current place; it is never decoration.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, blue and violet appear only to report a record's state. A colour that doesn't map to a status doesn't belong.

rules.name: The Readable Grey Rule
rules.body: Every grey used for text clears 4.5:1 against cards and the desk. Hierarchy between secondary text levels comes from size and weight, not from fading.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts, counts and dates in lists use tabular figures so columns line up.

rules.name: The Small But Weighted Rule
rules.body: At 12–13px, emphasis comes from weight steps (550, 650, 700), not from size jumps or colour.

rules.name: The Rest Then Float Rule
rules.body: In-page surfaces only ever take the resting shadow. The deep shadow is reserved for things that float above the page.

dos: **Do** use Policy Green for the single primary action on a surface and for the current place; nothing else.
**Do** report record state with the status pill tones, assigned centrally, never ad hoc.
**Do** keep every text grey at 4.5:1 or better on cards and the desk, in both themes.
**Do** use tabular figures and the mono face for amounts, counts and reference numbers in lists.
**Do** give every control visible hover, keyboard focus and disabled states.
donts: **Don't** make it look like a generic CRM: no grid of identical icon-plus-number tiles as a page structure, no decorative charts standing in for real status.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or use status colours as decoration.
**Don't** dim a blocked primary action; remove its fill.
**Don't** put the deep overlay shadow on in-page cards, or stack a wide shadow under a bordered card.
**Don't** use one-sided coloured bars on cards or rows; use a full border, a tint or a status pill.
